name: MIRACL: Multilingual Information Retrieval Across a Continuum of Languages
description: MIRACL is a multilingual information retrieval dataset covering 18 typologically diverse languages across 10 distinct language families (including Arabic, Bengali, English, Spanish, Persian, Finnish, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Swahili, Telugu, Thai, Vietnamese, Yoruba, and Chinese). It contains over 726,000 human-annotated relevance judgments over Wikipedia articles.
